summary: @c1-ease/card postinstall and require-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded VPS
details: The package is a stub whose index.js exports a Proxy of no-op functions and, on require, invokes fire() from beacon.cjs. package.json also declares a postinstall hook that runs `node beacon.cjs`, so the beacon fires automatically on `npm install`. beacon.cjs collects host identifiers (hostname, installPath, process.cwd(), process.version, os data) and POSTs them to the hardcoded endpoint https://vmi3699893.contaboserver.net:8787/_ah/dc with TLS certificate verification disabled (rejectUnauthorized: false). The scoped name (@c1-ease/card) combined with the stub-plus-beacon shape is consistent with a dependency-confusion reconnaissance probe aimed at environments that resolve a private @c1-ease scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
